title: B1 Milestone 4: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Cuarto Hito del Nivel B1. Tu capacidad para manejar entrevistas, presentaciones y escenarios imaginarios es excelente.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 16 a 19 del nivel B1: 
- Second Conditional (If I had time, I would...). 
- Presentations Vocab (Slide, overview, moving on to).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 16 to 19 of the B1 level: The Second Conditional for imaginary situations, and vocabulary for Presentations.

parts.visual:
- Passive Voice Basics (The email was sent, the product is made). 
- Job Interviews (Strengths, weaknesses, background, hire). 
¡Mucha suerte!
parts.audio: We will also review the basics of the Passive Voice, and vocabulary for Job Interviews. Good luck!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 16-19).

questions.question: If I ____ you, I would accept the job. (Fuera).
We ____ hire more people if we had a bigger budget. (Contrataríamos).
What would you do if they ____ the offer? (Rechazaran).
Let me show you the first ____ of my presentation. (Diapositiva).
____ on to the next topic, let's talk about sales. (Pasando a).
First, I'll give you a brief ____ of the company. (Visión general).
The report ____ sent yesterday. (Fue enviado).
These computers ____ made in China. (Son hechas).
The meeting ____ canceled due to bad weather. (Fue cancelada).
This email was written ____ the CEO. (Por).
Could you tell me about your educational ____? (Experiencia / Antecedentes).
What is your greatest ____? (Fortaleza).
My biggest ____ is that I am a perfectionist. (Debilidad).
We decided to ____ him because he is very talented. (Contratar).
She decided to ____ from her job. (Renunciar).
Please attach your ____ to the application. (Currículum).
If they ____ us more time, we would finish the project. (Dieran).
To ____, we must improve our customer service. (Resumir).
Two laptops ____ stolen from the office. (Fueron robadas).
Are you willing to ____ for this position? (Mudarte de ciudad).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el repaso escribiendo la palabra correcta.

questions.question: If I ____ you, I would do it. (Fuera)
We ____ hire him if we had money. (Auxiliar condicional)
Next ____. (Diapositiva con S)
____ on to the next point... (Pasando a...)
The email ____ sent yesterday. (Fue)
The products ____ made in China. (Son)
Your educational ____. (Antecedentes/Experiencia)
Your greatest ____. (Fortaleza)
We decided to ____ him. (Contratar)
Send your ____. (Currículum)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase de tu examen final.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If I were you, I would ask for a raise.
options: If I were you, I would ask for a raise.
If I was you, I would ask for a raise.
If I am you, I would ask for a raise.
If I were you, I will ask for a raise.
questions.correct_answer: If I were you, I would ask for a raise.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We would accept if they reduced the price.
options: We would accept if they reduced the price.
We will accept if they reduced the price.
We would accept if they reduce the price.
We accept if they reduced the price.
questions.correct_answer: We would accept if they reduced the price.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Let me show you the first slide.

Let me show you the next slide.
Let me share the first slide.
questions.correct_answer: Let me show you the first slide.
